title: SocioEval: A Template-Based Framework for Evaluating Socioeconomic Status Bias in Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Template-based evaluation using structured decision-making tasks where models are prompted to make explicit judgments between two socioeconomic class identities (e.g., lower/working class, middle class, upper-middle class, upper class) in positive and negative scenarios, followed by a three-stage human annotation protocol.
